ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black) to 35% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger, more jagged pixel amplitudes (peaks) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature on both trailing edges, tapering to sharp distal tips; leading edges show moderate convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the central black pigmented zone; darker linear marks are present on the white lateral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable white circular focal point (possible lesion or scar) centered above the notch; significant trailing edge erosion/irregularity on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, multi-directional linear rake marks creating a highly textured appearance in the central dark region.
